headline: As of 2026-11-01: 53,773,951 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 53,773,951 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,746,257), California (5,545,910), Florida (5,159,474).
